0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Cweilsaem has a favor to ask.

24.original: Deliver the small package to W'sondidi.

25.original: Drink the golden syrup near W'sondidi.

48.original: It's <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, isn't it? I was about to head to Kokkol's Forge to drop something off, but I think you'd be more welcome than I.

49.original: As it turns out, the recipient is something of an admirer of yours. I'm sure she'd be thrilled to have you make the delivery.

50.original: Thank you! Here's the package, all set to be delivered to W'sondidi.

51.original: W'sondidi is waiting for her delivery at Kokkol's Forge. I wish I could see the look on her face when she realizes it's you!

52.original: Hello th─<hex:021A020203>eep<hex:021A020103>! It's you! The one and only <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Am I dreaming?

53.original: A delivery for me? But why would someone as famous and important as you be delivering my package?

54.original: Oh, now I'm just being rude. I must thank you properly! If only I had known you'd be coming, I could have prepared something for you...

55.original: Silly me, there's something for you right here! This package contains a bottle of golden syrup. It's yours if you want it.

56.original: It's an alchemical medicine to rejuvenate the wearied body. You must need something like that after running around and saving the <hex:021A020203>entire world<hex:021A020103>.

57.original: I won't hear no for an answer, so drink it down! You deserve it far more than I do!

58.original: Please drink the syrup before you go. I'd never forgive myself if this delivery contributed to your exhaustion.

59.original: W'sondidi will be disappointed if you do not drink the medicine where she can see you.

60.original: The medicine is much sweeter than you were expecting.

64.original: I'm glad! I hope it nourishes your body along with pleasing your palate.

65.original: It <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> medicine, after all. Regardless of the flavor, I hope it does your body some good.

66.original: That reminds me, I had your comrade G'raha try some as well.

67.original: He seemed to quite enjoy it─said it was like drinking sweet ambrosia. I couldn't help but wonder what sort of medicine he had been forced to drink before...

68.original: Anyway, I'm afraid that's all I have to offer you. I swear, if Cweilsaem doesn't compensate you properly I just might─ Well, never mind that! Please take proper care of yourself out there.

69.original: Make sure Cweilsaem pays you properly!

70.original: All finished, then? She works herself too hard, that W'sondidi. The medicine I sent should be good for her.

71.original: Though I must say, you're looking rather more chipper than when you left.

72.original: Now that I look at you, you don't look too well yourself. Are you feeling all right?

73.original: What? She gave the syrup to you? Well, if that cheered her up, I suppose that's as good as any medicine. In any case, here's a little something as thanks for your help.
